statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
A mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) was ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
The diagnosis codes on the claim are R00.2 and R42.
Prior authorization was not obtained before the service date.
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197.
